profile.headline: Software Engineer at Blue
profile.summary: Experienced Embedded Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Defense & Space industry. Skilled in Microsoft Word, Eagle PCB, LaTeX, Android Development, and Assembly Language. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) Computer Engineering focused in Computer Engineering from CSULB.

positions.title: Promotor
positions.description: The Promotores de STEM serve as role-models. They are responsible for tutoring and mentoring undergraduate students in lower division courses and assist with HSI STEM program events, workshops, presentations, and recruitment efforts.

positions.title: lab assistant
positions.description: Assist a group of 20 students on their lab assignments. Tasks: troubleshoot software and hardware errors, explain main concepts for each assignment, and help students to prepare for test. Became familiar with the 8051 microcontroller and used C language to program it.

projects.title: Line following and Object detection robot:
projects.description: Using a microcontroller, color detection sensor and ultrasonic sensor I developed a small robotic vehicle. The robot follows a predetermined path and at every intersection of the path it scans for the nearest object’s distance and angle.

projects.title: Android mobile POS system
projects.description: Designed, developed and implemented a POS mobile software for a restaurant. The first version of the project was dedicated only for a sub section of the restaurant. The software performed so well, the project was extended to the whole restaurant.
